summary: ```# How to Upload and Sell Files in the MD Store ## Introduction Hello everyone, I am Xueli. Now, personal users can also sell their digital products on Marvelous Designer's official website. ## Account Registration First of all, if you do not have a Marvelous Designer official website account, please [click here to register](#). After registration, please log in to your account. ## Opening Your Business After logging in, you will see a pop-up window on the shop menu. This pop-up window will remind you that you are now open for business. If you want to upload your own files, you need to click on the link below. ## Uploading Files After clicking, it will redirect you to our Connect website. Once on this page, you can upload your own files and sell them. The Connect website is operated by another software company under our organization, developed by Clou. Clou users and Marvelous Designer (MD) users can sell their own 3D assets. ### Types of 3D Assets These 3D assets include, but are not limited to: - Clothing - Virtual models - Accessories (such as buttons or fabrics) ## File Upload Interface After logging in, click on the arrow in the upper right corner to access the file upload interface. ### Selecting File Types Once the upload page is open, you need to select the type of file you want to upload. There are two options: 1. **Closet Connect**: The uploaded files cannot be uploaded to the Marvelous Designer store at the same time. 2. **MD Store**: The uploaded files will be uploaded to both Connect and MDStore simultaneously. If you are a Marvelous Designer user, please select the option on the right. Ensure that your account is registered on the Marvelous Designer website before proceeding. ### Uploading the File Click on the "File" button, find your 3D file in the browser window, and select "Confirm." At the bottom, you can see the types of files we support uploading, which include but are not limited to: - Clothing - Project files - Virtual models - Accessories - Fabrics The maximum file size allowed for uploading is **500MB**. Be careful not to exceed this size. ## Service Terms At the bottom of the upload page, you can see our service terms. Click on it to view the service terms page. ## Completing the Upload After you upload the file, you will see a prompt indicating the upload is complete. Next, click on the "Next Step" button, which will take you to the details page. ### Adding Product Details On the details page, if you want to replace the file, click on "Replace." Enter the title and name of the product, followed by a description of the product that can include your inspiration, design idea, or clothing structure. ### Adding Labels At the bottom, you can add any labels you need. After entering the label, click on the "Enter" button to confirm. You can add multiple labels at the same time. ### Adding Images You can also add rendering images or any pictures that describe some details. On the entire webpage, there is a filter on the right-hand side for uploading the cover image of the product. Note that only one cover image is allowed. If you wish to replace the cover image, click on "Replace." For added images, there is a trash can icon in the upper right corner of each image; click on this icon to delete it. ## Classifying Your Product Before uploading, we will classify the product according to the uploaded file type. For clothing files, you need to select: - Gender - Clothing type - Purpose of wearing For example, you might choose a girl's dress. On the right side, you will see the type you have selected. You can switch to other options as needed. ### Purpose of Wearing The purpose of wearing refers to the context in which the clothing is applied, such as military clothing, daily wear, etc. If you need to see the translation clearly, you can pause the video. ## Pricing and Licensing After selecting the album, you can choose the type of price and license. You can set the project as either a paid project or a free project. ### Paid Project Fees If set as a paid project, there are two types of fees: - **Basic License Price**: For user purchases. - **Enterprise User Fee**: For purchases made by enterprise users. You can modify the price of this license according to your needs. After the enterprise user buys the license, they can use the purchased file in various projects. ### Free Projects You can set it as a free file or a file that can only be checked. Whether it is free or paid, there is an option called "food production." When selected, other users who have purchased this project can produce food based on it. ### Irreversible Settings Please note that the settings for paid and free projects are irreversible. Once you select one, you cannot switch to the other. ## Viewing Uploaded Projects After the official upload, you can view the project you uploaded in the 3D viewfinder on the screen. At the bottom of the screen, you can choose to delete the already uploaded project or edit the information previously filled out. ## Using the 3D Viewfinder To navigate the 3D viewfinder: - Use the scroll wheel to zoom in and out. - Press the right mouse button and drag to rotate. - Press the middle mouse button and drag to pan. ### Display Options You can switch the display type to see the grid distribution or choose a single color effect. If the file you are selling will be sold at the same time on the MDStore, please try to avoid including a virtual model. The clothing must be worn on a virtual model with information of the wearer stored in advance. ### Regulations on Clothing The clothing must be worn in the form of a virtual model T-pose and stored. These regulations exist to help users who use Marvelous Designer adapt their virtual models quickly to the clothing. ## Replacing Files If you need to adjust, you can replace the file again. Click "Edit" at the bottom to return to the edit page. After finding the replacement file on your computer, enter the reason for changing the file. ## Final Adjustments After replacing the file, you may need to adjust other descriptions, titles, and so on. Click "Next Step" again to return to the product classification page, where you can modify the types as needed. ## Creating a Main Page Click the image in the upper right corner of the webpage to return to your main page. At the top, you can upload a background picture, ideally sized at **3280 pixels**. Here, you can also enter your name, choose your profession (up to three), contact information, location, main page link, and a self-introduction. ### Album Creation On the right side, you can see the album you created. At the bottom of the album name, you can see all the projects belonging to that album. Click on the top of the list to add a new album and enter the name of this album. ## Uploading Products To upload a product, click "Upload" on the right side of the screen. You can also see a share icon next to it. After clicking the share icon, you can directly copy your main page link and share it with others. ## Conclusion That's it for the tutorial on the store. See you next time! Bye bye. ```
